description:
Dates with a saved daily snapshot. Every date (newest first, up to 400) on which a daily snapshot of this inventory was stored, plus `totals`:
each of those days' total value in cents (that day's holdings at that day's prices). Snapshots are written when
an inventory is looked up; fetch one with /inventory/{steamid}/snapshots/{date}. No key needed. Only inventories someone has looked up have snapshots. `totals` gives each saved day's total value (that day's holdings at that day's prices).
name: list_inventory_snapshots
title: Dates with a saved daily snapshot
